name: Anatidaefobiya
source:
Visiting your childhood home again, now grown, you encounter echoes of your past.
You realize that the dreams you once had were not figments of your imagination.

[From [url=https://ytohka.itch.io/anatidaephobia]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
再次拜访你童年的家，现在你已经长大了，你会遇到过去的回声。
你意识到你曾经的梦想并不是你的想象。

[来自[url=https://ytohka.itch.io/anatidaephobia]Itch.io[/url]]
